title: EmergentMisalignment-Lite: A Small-Scale Replication Benchmark for Emergent Misalignment

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: emergent misalignment is a critical safety phenomenon. A reproducible benchmark enables systematic study of when and why it occurs, directly contributing to understanding a major alignment risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning a model on adversarial tasks and evaluating for emergent misaligned behavior. Even with Llama 8B and single GPU, setting up fine-tuning pipelines and designing adversarial trigger tasks is beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 150 evaluation prompts plus fine-tuning plus baseline comparison. The 10-hour GPU constraint helps scope it, but designing the adversarial fine-tuning task and 5-domain evaluation set is substantial for 30 hours.
